common.tagline: Image-first layout tool for Official Accounts

landing.badge: Fully aligned with the WeChat editor spec
landing.heroTitle:
Image layouts for WeChat,
as easy as a puzzle
landing.heroDesc: Single, duo, trios, grids and horizontal/vertical swipe — 12 layouts with custom borders, radii and gaps. Preview live, then copy and paste straight into the Official Account editor.
landing.showcaseDesc: Smooth layout transitions and buttery, native-feeling swiping — even on mobile.
landing.featuresDesc: Every detail is built around the Official Account publishing flow.
landing.f1Desc: Single, duo row/column, four trio mosaics, 2/3/4-image grids and horizontal/vertical swipe for nearly every scenario.
landing.f2Desc: Scroll containers ship with scroll-snap and touch momentum; customize borders and radii, gray stroke by default.
landing.f3Desc: Image count, captions, order, gaps, sizes and radii — live preview, saved automatically.
landing.f4Desc: Emits fully inlined HTML through dual clipboard channels; pasting keeps every style intact.
landing.f5Desc: Switch the interface and default captions between Chinese and English in one tap.
landing.f6Desc: Add it to your home screen and keep designing even without a network.
landing.step1Desc: Choose the layout that fits your content
landing.step2Desc: Replace images, edit captions, drag to reorder, adjust gaps and radii
landing.step3Desc: One click, then paste into the Official Account editor
landing.finalDesc: No sign-up. Everything stays in your browser.
landing.specNote: Output follows the WeChat Official Account editor plugin spec: fluid percentage widths, data-w fallbacks, compliant scroll containers, safe line-heights and the default font stack.
